crumbs.label: Recognition of the Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP-2022) by Republic of Suriname

title: Recognition of the Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP-2022) by Republic of Suriname
bodyHtml:
Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (India) and Health Ministry of Suriname (Republic of Suriname) for recognition of the Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP-2022) on 05th June 2023.

Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP-2022) is now officially recognized by 05 Countries:-
1) Afghanistan
2) Ghana
3) Nepal
4) Mauritius
5) Republic of Suriname
